Detailed Description

The file imports OtherModule under the alias OM. Import-qualified and unqualified dot-path links; unqualified names resolve against the type's own module:

  • OtherModule.Layout
  • OtherModule.Button.text
  • Layout.fillHeight
  • Layout.values.integer
  • OM.Button.text
